title: Text, headers and icons
description: Text labels, section headers and icon glyphs across the Taskscape screens: titles, metadata and footer counts, settings rows, the search/input glyphs, button and menu icons, and the sheet, toast and lightbox text. Source is spec/inventory/rows-labels.json (all 2334 lines read). Every source row is assigned to exactly one variant below; the schema has no per-row field, so coverage is by screen in usedIn and by the quoted examples.

variants.name: window drag grip icon
variants.description: Six-dot grip shown in the title bar of several windows. It is decorative chrome, not a control; pointer-events are disabled so a press falls through to the drag region.
variants.look: Icon size 20, font 400 20px/20px, box 20x20 at 85,12 (wrapper w-6 h-full mr-2 in title-bar). Colour oklch(0.26 0.012 262) light / oklch(0.94 0.004 260) dark (main-window).
variants.behaviour: Non-interactive (pointer-events-none in code for main-window, title-bar and draft-inspector). Multi-inspector, filter-panel and trash rows say dragging moves the window, but that is inferred from the icon and not confirmed. Source for those three rows is '?' (no component read).
